name: 进门投研
description: Finenter MCP covers public roadshow content from securities firms, listed companies, and asset management institutions; integrates institutional-grade insights from domestic and international research reports and brokerage commentary; and provides real-time market data, financial data, quantitative factors, and more. Data Agent cleansing and structuring reduce token usage and improve response accuracy.
description_zh: 进门MCP覆盖券商、上市公司及资管机构的公开路演内容，整合内外资研报、券商点评等机构级观点，并提供实时行情、财务及量化因子等数据。经Data Agent清洗与结构化处理，减少Token消耗，提升回答准确率。
description_en: Finenter MCP covers public roadshow content from securities firms, listed companies, and asset management institutions; integrates institutional-grade insights from domestic and international research reports and brokerage commentary; and provides real-time market data, financial data, quantitative factors, and more. Data Agent cleansing and structuring reduce token usage and improve response accuracy.
examples_zh: 查询整理最近两周A股算力行业行情和市场观点及分歧
生成一份存储行业的边际变化报告
对比内外资机构对美联储最新议息会议的解读与市场预期，分析其对科技股走势和估值的潜在影响
回测低估值、高ROE因子在沪深300成分股中的历史表现
生成一份券商风格的早参日报，汇总隔夜市场表现、重要财经事件、机构观点和今日投资线索，并于每日8点30分定时生成
examples_en: Research and summarize market trends, prevailing views, and key disagreements in China's A-share computing-power sector over the past two weeks
Generate a report on recent marginal changes in the data storage sector

Compare domestic and international institutions' interpretations and market expectations regarding the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy meeting, and analyze its potential impact on technology stock performance and valuations
Backtest the historical performance of low-valuation, high-ROE factors among CSI 300 constituent stocks
Generate a brokerage-style morning research brief summarizing overnight market performance, major financial events, institutional views, and today's investment themes, scheduled daily at 8:30 AM
